note: Side objectives and the tutorial. `type` drives how progress is measured, `goal` is the number needed. `chain` groups a run of quests; only the lowest unfinished `step` of a chain is ever offered, so the UI can show it as a numbered list. `requires` names quests that must be done first. Rewards hand over resources, finish research work for free (`research`), complete a whole research node (`tech`), or add crew. `text` is the notification when it is offered, `done` the one when it completes. `hint` is one plain-language line the UI can put under the objective.

quests.name: Look at the Ground
quests.text: Nothing under the surface shows up until something looks at it. The pod swept a ring when it landed - read what it found.
quests.done: Six patches on the map. That circle around the pod is your whole world for the next ten minutes.
quests.hint: Open the map. Scanned patches are the coloured blobs; everything else is still hidden.

quests.name: Break Ground
quests.text: Put a rock drill on the iron patch next to the pod.
quests.done: The drill is turning and ore is going into the pod. That is the first link of every chain in this game.
quests.hint: Select Rock Drill I in the build list and click the iron patch. A drill has to sit on a scanned patch.

quests.name: Somewhere to Put It
quests.text: Drop a storage crate near the drill. Machines can only use what a store within reach is holding.
quests.done: Crate down. Anything inside the same pool of stores is shared for free - that is the rule the whole base is shaped by.
quests.hint: Crates within reach of each other join into one pool. The pod reaches 34 tiles on its own.

quests.name: First Pour
quests.text: Build a smelter and point it at Smelt Iron. Ore is not metal.
quests.done: Bars coming out. Two ore and a lump of coal make two bars, and the whole tree is built on them.
quests.hint: Build the smelter next to the crate, then choose Smelt Iron from its recipe list.

quests.name: Make the Run
quests.text: Set a delivery route between two stores so a truck hauls for you instead of you laying out the base around one crate.
quests.done: The truck is running. Every patch on the map is in reach of the base now, at the cost of a garage and a road.
quests.hint: Click a store, then Route, then pick a destination store and a resource.

quests.name: Keep the Lights On
quests.text: Three hundred kilowatts. Every machine you build stops the moment the grid cannot pay for it.
quests.done: Three hundred kilowatts and steady. Watch the grid number - a brownout slows every machine at once.
quests.hint: Build a combustion generator and run power poles from it to your machines.

quests.name: Start Reading
quests.text: Build a lab, make survey packs, and finish three research nodes. Research is your factory's throughput, not a separate currency.
quests.done: Three nodes done. Packs are made from what you already make, so a bigger factory is a faster tree.
quests.hint: Labs eat science packs. Point an assembler at Survey Pack and put a lab next to a crate.

quests.name: Eyes Open
quests.text: Build a scanner tower away from the pod. It looks underground, and it is the cheapest thing you will ever build per unit of value.
quests.done: Another ring of the map is readable. Put these where you want to build next, not where you already are.
quests.hint: Scanner towers only reveal patches. A radar reveals the surface too.

quests.name: Draw a Line
quests.text: Six pieces of defence - wall, watchtower, whatever you can afford. Something out there has noticed the smoke.
quests.done: There is a line now. A wall buys time; the turret behind it does the work.
quests.hint: Turrets need to cover the side your base is noisiest on. Waves come in from the nearest map edge.

quests.name: Make the Run
quests.text: Walking distance is not a base plan. Set up a delivery route between two stores.
quests.done: The first truck is running. Now every ore patch on the map is in reach.

quests.name: Keep the Lights On
quests.text: Two hundred kilowatts of generation. Machines stop the moment the grid does.
quests.done: Two hundred kilowatts and steady. Brownouts slow every machine at once - watch that number.

quests.name: First Contact
quests.text: Something out there has noticed the smoke. Survive the first attack.
quests.done: They came, they died at the wall. They will come back bigger - the smoke you make is what calls them.

quests.name: Draw a Line
quests.text: Put forty pieces of defence between the swarms and your machines.
quests.done: There is a perimeter now. A wall only buys time - the turrets behind it do the work.

quests.name: Look Over the Hill
quests.text: Send scouts into three neighbouring regions and see what is there.
quests.done: Three regions mapped. There is more iron out there than under your feet, and worse things too.

quests.name: Complete Survey
quests.text: Scan every ore node on this local map. Know exactly what you are standing on.
quests.done: Every ore patch on the map is on the map. Now you can plan a base instead of reacting to one.

quests.name: Steel Age
quests.text: A hundred steel ingots. Everything past this point is bolted to steel.
quests.done: A hundred bars of steel. The buildings stop being brick and start being machines.

quests.name: Pave It
quests.text: A hundred tiles of road and logistics. Hauling is most of your throughput problem.
quests.done: The roads are in. Every truck you own just got faster without you buying a single truck.

quests.name: Eyes Open
quests.text: Build a radar. Fighting blind is how bases die.
quests.done: Radar up. You will see the next wave forming instead of hearing it hit the wall.

quests.name: Burn the Nest
quests.text: There is a nest out there raising the threat every second it stands. Destroy one.
quests.done: Nest cleared, and the threat score dropped with it. Nests are why waves grow even when you are quiet.

quests.name: Wet Chemistry
quests.text: Sixty units of acid. Half the mid-game recipe list runs through a chemical plant.
quests.done: Acid flowing. From here the tree branches - polymers, batteries, enrichment.

quests.name: Something New
quests.text: This planet has an element you have never mined. Find it, scan it, and put a drill on it.
quests.done: The rare element is flowing. Its own buildings are researchable now, and they do things nothing else can.

quests.name: Local Advantage
quests.text: Build the planet-specific machine this world unlocked. It exists nowhere else.
quests.done: It is running. Every planet has one trick nowhere else has - this one is yours.

quests.name: Standing Library
quests.text: Finish twenty research nodes.
quests.done: Twenty nodes done. Build an archive before you leave or you relearn all of it.

quests.name: Ten Waves Deep
quests.text: Hold the base through ten attacks.
quests.done: Ten waves held. What comes next is armoured, and some of it flies.

quests.name: Industrial Grid
quests.text: Two megawatts of generation. The late machines each eat a small town's worth.
quests.done: Two megawatts. Now the nano forge and the laser line are actually affordable to run.

quests.name: Eyes in Orbit
quests.text: Build a satellite and put it up. The whole world map opens the moment it is in orbit.
quests.done: Satellite up and the map is open. Orbital packs are available now, which is the last research tier.

quests.name: Look Ahead
quests.text: Send a probe at another planet. Know what is there before you spend a rocket getting there.
quests.done: Probe arrived. That world's resources and hazards are on the chart - pick your next home with your eyes open.

quests.name: Stack the Stages
quests.text: Six rocket sections. That is a launch.
quests.done: Six sections on the pad. Load the hold with everything you want on the next world - what you leave behind is gone.

quests.name: Leave the Ground
quests.text: Load the pad and launch. Whatever is in the hold comes with you; whatever is not, does not.
quests.done: Launched. New planet, new rules, and the research you archived came along for the ride.

quests.name: Somewhere to Stand
quests.text: Six station modules and an orbital lift. Build a place in orbit that does not need a rocket every time.
quests.done: The station is crewed. Cargo goes up on the lift now - the rocket bill for every future launch just collapsed.

quests.name: Plant the Flag
quests.text: Light a frontier beacon on this world.
quests.done: Beacon lit and burning. Light them on enough worlds and the frontier is formally yours.

quests.name: Before They Come
quests.text: Get a turret standing before the first attack arrives. Reacting to a wave is always more expensive than expecting one.
quests.done: A gun was waiting for them. That is the cheapest wave you will ever fight.
quests.hint: The grace period is on the threat readout. Build a watchtower or a gun turret before it runs out.

quests.name: Five Deep
quests.text: Hold the base through five attacks. Every fifth one comes from two sides at once.
quests.done: Five waves held, including a push from two fronts. From here they start bringing armour.
quests.hint: Surge waves split across two edges - a ring of turrets beats a wall on one side.

quests.name: One Megawatt
quests.text: A megawatt of generation. The chemistry and electronics tiers each eat a small town's worth.
quests.done: A megawatt on the meter. Now the printers and the electrolyser can run at the same time.
quests.hint: Solar is quiet and makes no threat; coal is cheap and calls things to your door.

quests.name: Lay the Concrete
quests.text: Put down your first paved road. Pavement is worth more than a bigger truck on the same route.
quests.done: Paved. A truck on that road moves about twice as fast as one crossing raw ground.
quests.hint: Pave the busiest run first - the one between your ore outpost and the smelters.

quests.name: Wet Freight
quests.text: Run a tanker route. Liquids will not ride in a crate truck, and half the mid-game needs water.
quests.done: The tanker is looping. Oil, water, acid and fuel can all leave the patch they were found on now.
quests.hint: A tanker needs a tanker bay for a garage and a fluid tank at each end.

quests.name: Burn Them Out
quests.text: Three nests down. Every one left standing raises the threat every second of the run.
quests.done: Three nests gone and the threat curve is visibly flatter. Artillery pays for itself here.
quests.hint: Artillery shells nests from 44 tiles without anything having to walk out there.

quests.name: Every Seam
quests.text: Scan every rare-element patch on this map. They are small, and they are the only ones here.
quests.done: Every seam of it on the chart. What this planet gives you, it gives you here and nowhere else.
quests.hint: A long radar or a satellite finds the ones a scanner tower missed.

quests.name: Somewhere Else
quests.text: Land on a second world. Whatever the hold carried is all you have until the first drill turns.
quests.done: Down on a new world with a different rule book. Build an archive before the next launch.
quests.hint: Only the cargo in the hold and the research an archive was holding come with you.

quests.name: The Frontier
quests.text: Light a beacon on enough worlds to claim the frontier, and finish the orbital station.
quests.done: The chain is lit. Everything out here was built from the ground up, twice over.
quests.hint: Beacons plus a complete six-module station wins the run.

quests.name: Signal in the Dust
quests.text: Something is reading back off the survey band from two regions over. Send scouts to both.
quests.done: Both regions mapped, and one of them is sitting on a seam this valley does not have.
quests.hint: Build a dormitory for crew room, spawn a scout, then pick a region on the world map.

quests.name: Deep Seam
quests.text: The scouts brought back an assay. Find the seam on your own ground, scan it and put a drill on it.
quests.done: The seam is running, and the cache the scouts marked came in with it - enough heavy metal to start an alloy line.
quests.hint: Rare patches are small and often outside the pod's first scan. This is what the second scanner tower is for.

quests.name: Long Haul
quests.text: Five regions surveyed. The shielding recipe is out there in somebody's wreck, not in your labs.
quests.done: Re-entry shielding read straight off a hull that survived one. That is a rocket section's worth of research you did not have to pay for.
quests.hint: Region surveys are the cheapest research in the game if you have a skimmer to do them.

quests.name: First Stage
quests.text: One rocket section. Everything upstream of it has to be running at once for that to happen.
quests.done: A section on the gantry, and the fuel for the launch is in the tanks. Five more.
quests.hint: A section wants alloy plate, superalloy, control units, a heat shield and rocket fuel - six chains meeting in one machine.

chains.name: Landfall
chains.desc: The first twenty minutes, one step at a time: scan, drill, store, haul, smelt, power, research, look further, and draw a line.

chains.name: The Far Seam
chains.desc: The rocket is gated behind exploration: what this valley does not have, the next region does. Survey, assay, haul it home, and the first stage goes on the gantry.
